data.name: Josianne
data.gender_notes: Josianne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Josiah, which means 'God heals'. In the Bible, Josiah was a righteous king who restored the temple in Jerusalem and led the Israelites to repentance. The name Josianne carries the meaning “God's healer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Josianne usually hope their child will grow to embody god's healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Josianne belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's healer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Josianne total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_greek.name: Ιωσηάννα
in_greek.meaning: η Ιωσηάννα, είναι μια μορφή της Ιωσηφ, που περιέχει την έννοια της χάριτος
in_greek.long_meaning: η Ιωσηάννα, είναι μια μορφή της Ιωσηφ, που περιέχει την έννοια της χάριτος, και της ευχής, με την οποία θα γίνει γνωστό τον κόσμο, ότι ο Θεός είναι αγαπητός. Η Ιωσηάννα, είναι μια μορφή της χάριτος, και της ευχής, της Μαρίας, και του Ιωσηφ. in_latin.name: Josianne

in_latin.long_meaning: Josianne est forma feminina nominis Ioseph, qui continet notionem gratiae, et bonitatis, per quam mundus cognoscet Deum esse amabilem.
